name: Bo nhung giam
summary: Trảng Bàng young beef dipped in vinegar, one of the plates from the young-beef rooms on Quốc lộ 22. The beef is naturally sweet and soft.
origin: Trảng Bàng, Tây Ninh. The beef comes from animals of about 5 to 6 months, naturally sweet and soft.
howToEat: Order it with the other young-beef plates at a Trảng Bàng beef room, where the signature is the beef rolled in bánh tráng phơi sương.
where: The young-beef rooms of phường Trảng Bàng, phường An Tịnh, and Quốc lộ 22.
seoTitle: Bo nhung giam in Trang Bang
seoDescription: Bò nhúng giấm, Trảng Bàng young beef dipped in vinegar.
